text.content:
Mercenaries for hire, and North Oak's guard dogs.

Headquarters: Lazarus Regional HQ (#71), the Glen
Industry: Private military and security contracting
In Night City: Guards the North Oak gates and estates
Dealing with edgerunners: Hiring, always. In North Oak it doesn't give warnings

A mercenary company with its regional headquarters in the Glen, and always hiring. In Night City it is best known as the guard on North Oak: Lazarus patrols the gates and private teams patrol everything inside them. A drawn weapon in North Oak brings estate security within seconds and Lazarus within a minute.

Captain Duke Okonkwo runs the North Oak gate patrols, and treats the job as a war.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 05, 09, 10
